department: Computational and Applied Physics (Departments of Applied Physics and Physics and Nuclear Engineering)

deadline.value: Applications are accepted throughout the academic year under UPC's general rule; the programme page sets no separate date.
deadline.quote: As a general rule, you can apply for a doctoral programme throughout the academic year.

supervisor.value: Admission depends on a programme teacher being available to supervise the thesis, so a supervisor must be found before admission.
supervisor.quote: Even if the admission requirements are fulfilled, admissions will be subject to the availability of one of the teachers of the doctoral programme to supervise the thesis.

funding.value: UPC predoctoral grants are awarded through annual general calls; the programme pages do not say how many students are funded.
funding.quote: General calls of predoctoral grants, financed by state and autonomous public bodies, the UPC, and private foundations.

entry_route.value: Applicants must hold an official Spanish bachelor's degree or equivalent and a master's degree.
entry_route.quote: To be eligible to enter a doctoral programme, a candidate must hold an official Spanish bachelor's degree (or equivalent) and a master's degree.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test is mentioned on the programme pages.

notes: Enrolment requires a signed student-supervisor agreement (CDDT) after admission. Grants page lists one example (BE-OPTICAL) and a job opening; no competitive call text on the programme site. Astronomy is not a separate UPC PhD (only a research group is listed), so no astronomy record.
name: PhD in Computational and Applied Physics
